name: Normal attacks use the charge attack's accuracy (3x DEX)

evidence.semantics: Player normal attacks use A = 3*DEX in the hit roll floor(125*(A+10)/(A+D+20)) >= rand%100, the same A every charge attack already uses. Weapon skill level is not part of the vanilla accuracy formula at any level, so nothing else from the charge attack carries over.
